description: This file defines an abstract base class for entity functions within the Apache OFBiz framework, including specific implementations for functions like LENGTH, TRIM, UPPER, and LOWER, along with utility methods for creating and handling these functions.

classes.name: EntityFunction
classes.description: Abstract base class for entity functions with nested and single value implementations, providing methods for SQL generation, value retrieval, and equality checks.

classes.name: EntityFunction.LENGTH
classes.description: Implementation of LENGTH function returning the length of a string or entity value.

classes.name: EntityFunction.TRIM
classes.description: Implementation of TRIM function removing whitespace from string or entity value.

classes.name: EntityFunction.UPPER
classes.description: Implementation of UPPER function converting string or entity value to uppercase.

classes.name: EntityFunction.LOWER
classes.description: Implementation of LOWER function converting string or entity value to lowercase.

classes.name: EntityFunction.EntityFunctionSingle
classes.description: Abstract class for entity functions operating on a single value.

classes.name: EntityFunction.EntityFunctionNested
classes.description: Abstract class for entity functions operating on nested entity condition values.

methods.name: length
methods.description: Creates a LENGTH entity function for a nested or direct value.

methods.name: trim
methods.description: Creates a TRIM entity function for a nested or direct value.

methods.name: upper
methods.description: Creates an UPPER entity function for a nested or direct value.

methods.name: lower
methods.description: Creates a LOWER entity function for a nested or direct value.
